title: celastrus cuneatus
intro: Celastrus cuneatus, commonly known as Spiny Woodbine, is a type of climbing plant native to the Himalayas and parts of China. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Ayurvedic and Unani medicine. Celastrus cuneatus is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, reduce oxidative stress, and prevent the growth of cancer cells. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-diabetic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids.
